run_read_binarized_with_dict: run the script to read a binarized fairseq dataset and decode tokens using a dictionary file
run_read_binarized_without_dict: run the script to read a binarized fairseq dataset and output raw token IDs as space-separated integers
run_read_binarized_with_impl: run the script with a specific dataset implementation to read a binarized fairseq file
review_get_parser: review the get_parser function that configures argparse with --input, --dict, and --dataset-impl arguments
review_main: review the main function that loads an indexed dataset and prints decoded or raw token lines to stdout
